core_requests: core/links.py + renderers + `v3lum links` (P311, A2): honour a per-link max_tlp (shipped as x_max_tlp; P203 cond 10 OnionSearchEngine, P290 cond 9 SSL Labs hidden at TLP:AMBER+ unless expanded). The SSL Labs pack link is still shown defanged at AMBER by ui/render.py.

core/links.py (P311): resolver placeholders so packs can hold the links rendered today by modules from x_module_links: {mitre_path} (T1059.001 -> T1059/001), {attack_id} (G/S id from P292/P295), {malpedia_id} (P295 galaxy refs), per-tracker slugs {ransomlook_slug}/{rlive_slug}, chain-validated {btc}/{ltc}/{doge}/{bch}/{tron}/{evm} (or an x_accepts key checked with validators.crypto_address_info); plus x_warning and x_fallback_for. Until then those links are absent from `v3lum links` and from every view at TLP:RED. Reference implementation: v3lum/modules/utility/pivot_pack_render.py.

core/links.py (P311): accept placeholder-less pack links for static manual-entry pages (x_static: consumidor.gov.br, SINTEGRA, P250 cond 10-11); only inline Module.manual_link templates may lack a placeholder today.

core/links.py lint_pack (P311): add the batch rules now enforced only by pivot_pack_render.PACK_RULES and the CI test: rule-3 claim/leak/download/victim paths for darkweb packs (P203 cond 9), wallet-connect/payment/swap/donation pages (P216 cond 10), GrayhatWarfare file links/downloads (P290 cond 8), ViewDNS reverseip/iphistory (P231 cond 11), SSL Labs hideResults=on&latest + touches_target (P290 cond 9), .onion hosts (P203 cond 11).

core/models.py ModuleResult.link: carry host, verified, antibot, badge, privacy, touches_target and category (structured link items like engine._link_item), so module links get the same renderer treatment as pack links; today the label repeats 'opening sends <value> to <host>' and the terminal shows it twice at AMBER.

doctor --links (P311 cond 7 of every pack, offline): list unverified links and links not re-checked for more than 180 days, x_module_links included; pivot_pack_render.recheck_report(today) returns that data for the six batch packs.
core/entities.py display_value: show the EIP-55 form of eth_address values (P216 cond 8: lower case for matching, checksum for display, as P219 does).

core/validators.py (P217): add Bitcoin Cash cashaddr and Litecoin bech32 to crypto_address_info (pivots_crypto validates them locally: cashaddr_payload, validators.segwit_decode('ltc', ...)); btc_address normalisation accepts testnet (tb1), so mainnet-only pack links render for testnet values.

actor_alias_index (P295, batch p1-G11-1): per-tracker group names (RansomLook, ransomware.live) for P203 cond 8; darkweb.json ships a curated 7-group x_tracker_slugs table meanwhile. Actor Malpedia ids are rare in the bundled index (P300 cond 9).

Engine / `v3lum org show` (P290 cond 8, A11): render GrayhatWarfare links for org_profile brands without writing profile entries into case data; pivots_pentest covers analyst-typed own-asset seeds only.
core/lint.py SUBMISSION_PATTERNS: the generic 'submit' pattern rejects OnionSearchEngine's '&submit=Search' form-button parameter; the template now omits it (unverified until a browser check).
Architect decision (P250): the frozen lint makes CNPJ templates privacy=true, so Brazilian company links render only for analyst-typed CNPJ seeds of an opted-in case, never for discovered CNPJs.
notes: Six G14 pivot packs in the frozen v3lum.pivot_pack/1 schema plus five offline (disclosure 'none', terms open, opsec passive, default_enabled true, max_requests 0) modules; P231 is pack-only (no Module class; its 'file' is the pack). Links the frozen core cannot render correctly (per-site tracker slugs, {mitre_path}, ATT&CK/Malpedia ids from P295, chain-validated addresses, max_tlp, warnings, static pages) live in each pack under the pack-level extension key x_module_links and are rendered by the pack's module through v3lum/modules/utility/pivot_pack_render.py: core lint on a {q} view of each entry plus batch rules, re.sub whitelist substitution, URL re-check, registry tier at render time, fail closed. Provider fragments: 13 new providers owned by this batch (onionsearchengine and bitref unknown tier; bitcoinwhoswho, arkham, escavador, casadosdados community; opencorporates, companies_house, reclameaqui, jusbrasil, consumidor_gov, sintegra, ssllabs trusted; ssllabs flags fetches_target) and 7 extensions (blockchain_com, etherscan incl. bscscan.com, ethplorer, tronscan, gleif, rfb, ransomware_live); ransomlook, mempool_space, blockchair, walletexplorer, opensanctions, viewdns, transparencia, grayhatwarfare, malpedia and mitre already registered the link hosts. Owners.json mapped blockchain.com, ethplorer.io, tronscan.org, etherscan.io and ransomware.live to null, but their providers exist now (other batches): extended, not recreated. Coordination with p2-G14-3 (P304): Etherscan, BscScan, Tronscan and Arkham ship in crypto.json (unverified, antibot); Chainabuse is left to P304 per P216 cond 10. Known gaps are in docs/backlog/p2-G14-2.md (max_tlp not honoured by renderers for SSL Labs, resolver links absent from `v3lum links`, testnet BTC, CNPJ privacy rule, Arkham/BitcoinWhosWho/OpenCorporates/GLEIF unverified). No LIGHT/ACTIVE variant was asked. Prep raw captures (victim lists, PEP names, bucket file names) were not copied: fixtures keep URL, status and title only.
